question: Which team won the Vijay Hazare Trophy 2021 – 22?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Himachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vijay Hazare Trophy 2021 – 22 **was the **20th season** of the **Vijay Hazare Trophy.**
 
• It is a **List A cricket tournament **in India.
 
• The game began on **December 8** and ran through** December 26.**
 
• The reigning champion was** Mumbai.**
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** secured their first domestic championship after **defeating Tamil Nadu** in the decisive game by a **score of 11 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** 2022–23 Vijay Hazare Trophy** was the** 21st season** of the** Vijay Hazare Trophy.**
 
• **2022's 12 November–2 December** saw it in action.
 
• The reigning champions at the time were** Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• To win their **second domestic championship, Saurashtra** defeated **Maharashtra **in the decisive game by a margin of **five wickets.**
